title: BTU Calculation Methodology
overview: BTU (British Thermal Unit) calculations size HVAC equipment for heating and cooling. Proper sizing ensures comfort and energy efficiency.

methods.name: Rule of Thumb Estimation
methods.description: Quick estimate: 20 BTU per square foot for cooling. Actual needs vary by climate and building.

formula.name: Basic BTU Estimate
formula.expression:
Cooling BTU ≈ Square Footage × 20
Tons of AC = BTU / 12,000

methods.name: Manual J (ACCA Standard)
methods.description: Industry standard load calculation considering all factors: windows, insulation, orientation, climate zone, occupancy.

footnotes: Oversized AC cycles too frequently, increasing humidity
Undersized equipment runs constantly, never reaching setpoint
High ceilings, large windows, and poor insulation increase load
